name: FORKBOMB Face Swap (fbswap)
summary: Modular face-swap pipeline built from the most permissive parts available, with consent, watermark and synthetic-media metadata on by default.
job: Swap a consenting person's face into an image/video locally; every output is visibly and machine-readably marked AI-GENERATED.
run: pip install -e apps/faceswap && fbswap models fetch && fbswap web
